name: Mirror of Malice
skillFull: Dark Stone Jellies appear at certain intervals. Collect a certain number of Dark Stone Jellies to release the Beam of Malice, destroying obstacles and creating Malicious Spirit Jellies. Level Up for more points for Dark Malicious Spirit Jellies.
